title: Products, carts and users can be created, changed and deleted without logging in
description: Anyone, without logging in, can delete products, delete customer accounts, or create shopping carts in another customer's name. Changing data should only be allowed for logged-in people who own the data or are administrators. Right now any visitor or script could wipe or tamper with the store.
steps: Send DELETE https://fakestoreapi.com/users/1 with no Authorization header -> 200 with the deleted user
POST /carts with {"userId":1,...} and no token -> 201 (cart created for user 1)
expected: 401 Unauthorized without a valid token; 403 when the user does not own the data.
actual: 200/201 for every write without any token.
notes: The spec defines no security scheme; reported as a security issue per the test guidelines. Writes are not persisted on this demo API.
